fact: The Ministry and WFP launched the School Feeding Information Management System (NaSIS) on 4 July 2023, with digital school rolls and attendance tracking to follow in a later instalment, for more than 400,000 pre-primary and primary pupils in 1,500 schools.
title: The Ministry of Education, Arts and Culture and the World Food Programme in Namibia jointly launched the Namibia School Feeding Information Management System (NaSIS)
